q.en: Which is the phylogenetically oldest division of the cerebellum (archicerebellum / vestibulocerebellum), responsible for balance and the vestibulo-ocular reflex?
q.uz: Miyachaning muvozanat va vestibulo-okulyar refleks uchun javobgar bo'lgan filogenetik eng qadimgi bo'limi (arxiserebellum / vestibuloserebellum) qaysi?

options.en: Flocculonodular lobe (lobule X — flocculus and nodulus), separated by the posterolateral fissure
options.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha — flokkulus va nodulus), orqa-lateral yoriq bilan ajralgan

options.en: Anterior lobe (lobules I–V), separated from the posterior lobe by the primary fissure
options.uz: Oldingi bo'lak (I–V bo'lakchalar), orqa bo'lakdan birlamchi yoriq bilan ajralgan

options.en: Lateral posterior lobe hemispheres (Crus I and Crus II / neocerebellum)
options.uz: Orqa bo'lak lateral yarimsharlari (Crus I va Crus II / neoserebellum)

options.en: Cerebellar tonsils (lobule IX) on the inferior vermian aspect
options.uz: Pastki chuvalchang yuzasidagi miyacha bodomchalari (IX bo'lakcha)

why.en: The flocculonodular lobe (lobule X, comprising the midline nodulus and paired lateral flocculi) is the oldest cerebellar division (archicerebellum / vestibulocerebellum). Separated from the corpus cerebelli by the posterolateral fissure, it receives direct primary and secondary vestibular afferents and regulates equilibrium and gaze stabilization.
why.uz: Flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha — o'rta chiziqdagi nodulus va juft lateral flokkuluslar) miyachaning eng qadimgi bo'limidir (arxiserebellum / vestibuloserebellum). Miyacha tanasidan orqa-lateral yoriq bilan ajralgan bo'lib, bevosita birlamchi va ikkilamchi vestibulyar tolalarni qabul qiladi hamda muvozanat va nigohni barqarorlashtirishni boshqaradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Which deep fissure on the superior surface of the cerebellum separates the anterior lobe (lobules I–V) from the posterior lobe (lobules VI–IX)?
q.uz: Miyachaning ustki yuzasidagi qaysi chuqur yoriq oldingi bo'lakni (I–V bo'lakchalar) orqa bo'lakdan (VI–IX bo'lakchalar) ajratib turadi?

options.en: Primary fissure (fissura prima)
options.uz: Birlamchi yoriq (fissura prima)

options.en: Posterolateral fissure
options.uz: Orqa-lateral yoriq (fissura posterolateralis)

options.en: Horizontal fissure (splitting Crus I and Crus II)
options.uz: Gorizontal yoriq (Crus I va Crus II ni ajratuvchi)

options.en: Retrotonsillar fissure
options.uz: Retrotonsillyar yoriq

why.en: The primary fissure (fissura prima) on the superior cerebellar surface divides the anterior lobe (lobules I–V, primarily spinocerebellar sensorimotor representation) from the much larger posterior lobe (lobules VI–IX, between the primary and posterolateral fissures).
why.uz: Miyacha ustki yuzasidagi birlamchi yoriq (fissura prima) oldingi bo'lakni (I–V bo'lakchalar, asosan spinoserebellyar sensorimotor vakillik) ancha yirik orqa bo'lakdan (birlamchi va orqa-lateral yoriqlar orasidagi VI–IX bo'lakchalar) ajratadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: What is the correct order of the four deep cerebellar nuclei from LATERAL to MEDIAL?
q.uz: Miyachaning to'rtta chuqur yadrosining LATERALDAN MEDIALGA tomon to'g'ri joylashish tartibi qanday?

options.en: Dentate → Emboliform → Globose → Fastigial
options.uz: Tishsimon (dentatus) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii)

options.en: Fastigial → Globose → Emboliform → Dentate
options.uz: Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Sharsimon (globosus) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Tishsimon (dentatus)

options.en: Dentate → Fastigial → Emboliform → Globose
options.uz: Tishsimon (dentatus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus)

options.en: Emboliform → Dentate → Fastigial → Globose
options.uz: Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Tishsimon (dentatus) → Cho'qqi (fastigii) → Sharsimon (globosus)

why.en: Embedded in the cerebellar white matter dorsal to the fourth ventricle, the four paired deep nuclei run from lateral to medial: Dentate (largest, crumpled bag) → Emboliform → Globose (together termed the interposed nucleus) → Fastigial (most medial, near the midline roof of the fourth ventricle). Mnemonic: 'Don't Eat Greasy Food'.
why.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha orqasidagi miyacha oq moddasida joylashgan to'rtta juft chuqur yadro lateraldan medialga quyidagicha joylashadi: Tishsimon (dentatus — eng yirik, burmalangan xaltacha) → Tiqinsimon (emboliformis) → Sharsimon (globosus; ikkalasi birgalikda oraliq yadro — nucleus interpositus deyiladi) → Cho'qqi (fastigii — eng medial, IV qorincha tomi o'rta chizig'i yaqinida).

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Which neuron type forms the SOLE output of the three-layered cerebellar cortex, and what is its neurotransmitter action on the deep cerebellar nuclei?
q.uz: Uch qavatli miyacha po'stlog'idan chiquvchi YAGONA efferent neyron turi qaysi va u chuqur yadrolarga qanday neyromediator ta'sir ko'rsatadi?

options.en: Purkinje cells — purely inhibitory (GABAergic) projections onto the deep cerebellar and vestibular nuclei
options.uz: Purkine hujayralari — chuqur miyacha va vestibulyar yadrolarga sof tormozlovchi (GAMK-ergik) proyeksiyalar

options.en: Granule cells — excitatory (glutamatergic) axons leaving via the superior cerebellar peduncle
options.uz: Donador hujayralar — ustki miyacha oyoqchasi orqali chiquvchi qo'zg'atuvchi (glutamatergik) aksonlar

options.en: Basket and stellate cells — excitatory projections directly to the motor thalamus
options.uz: Savatcha va yulduzsimon hujayralar — motor talamusga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qo'zg'atuvchi proyeksiyalar

options.en: Golgi cells — cholinergic projections to the inferior olivary nucleus
options.uz: Golji hujayralari — pastki oliva yadrosiga xolinergik proyeksiyalar

why.en: The cerebellar cortex has three uniform layers (outer molecular, middle Purkinje cell monolayer, inner granular). Purkinje cells are the sole output neurons of the cerebellar cortex; they use GABA to inhibit the deep cerebellar nuclei (and lateral vestibular nucleus), carving precise timing out of the tonic excitatory drive in the deep nuclei.
why.uz: Miyacha po'stlog'i uchta bir xil qavatdan (tashqi molekulyar, o'rta Purkine hujayralari qavati, ichki donador) iborat. Purkine hujayralari miyacha po'stlog'idan chiquvchi yagona neyronlar bo'lib, GAMK yordamida chuqur miyacha yadrolarini (va lateral vestibulyar yadroni) tormozlaydi hamda chuqur yadrolarning tonik qo'zg'alishini aniq vaqt bo'yicha shakllantiradi.

q.en: Which cerebellar peduncle is the largest, consists exclusively of AFFERENT fibres from the contralateral basilar pontine nuclei, and carries descending cerebral cortical motor plans?
q.uz: Qaysi miyacha oyoqchasi eng yirik bo'lib, faqat qarama-qarshi bazilyar ko'prik yadrolaridan keluvchi AFFERENT tolalardan iborat va katta yarimsharlar po'stlog'ining harakat rejalarini olib keladi?

options.en: Middle cerebellar peduncle (brachium pontis)
options.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium pontis)

options.en: Superior cerebellar peduncle (brachium conjunctivum)
options.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium conjunctivum)

options.en: Inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform and juxtarestiform bodies)
options.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (arqonsimon va yukstarestiform tanalar)

options.en: Superior medullary velum
options.uz: Ustki miya chodiri (velum medullare superius)

why.en: The middle cerebellar peduncle (MCP / brachium pontis) is a massive, purely afferent white-matter bundle carrying crossed transverse pontocerebellar fibres (the second stage of the corticopontocerebellar pathway) from the contralateral pontine nuclei into the cerebellar hemispheres.
why.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (MCP / brachium pontis) yirik, sof afferent oq modda tutami bo'lib, qarama-qarshi ko'prik yadrolaridan kesishgan ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalarni (kortikopontoserebellyar yo'lning ikkinchi bo'g'ini) miyacha yarimsharlariga olib kiradi.

q.en: Which cerebellar peduncle serves as the primary EFFERENT outflow tract of the cerebellum, carrying axons from the dentate and interposed nuclei toward the red nucleus and motor thalamus?
q.uz: Qaysi miyacha oyoqchasi tishsimon va oraliq yadrolardan qizil yadro hamda motor talamusga yo'naluvchi aksonlarni tashib, miyachaning asosiy EFFERENT chiqish yo'li vazifasini bajaradi?

options.en: Superior cerebellar peduncle (brachium conjunctivum)
options.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium conjunctivum)

options.en: Middle cerebellar peduncle (brachium pontis)
options.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchasi (brachium pontis)

options.en: Inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform body)
options.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (arqonsimon tana)

options.en: Cerebral peduncle (crus cerebri)
options.uz: Miya oyoqchasi (crus cerebri)

why.en: The superior cerebellar peduncle (SCP / brachium conjunctivum) forms the principal efferent outflow of the cerebellum. Originating mainly from the dentate, emboliform, and globose nuclei, its fibres ascend in the dorsolateral pontine roof and decussate completely at the caudal midbrain (inferior colliculus level, O1) to reach the contralateral red nucleus and VLp (Vim) thalamus.
why.uz: Ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (SCP / brachium conjunctivum) miyachaning asosiy efferent chiqish yo'lidir. Asosan tishsimon, tiqinsimon va sharsimon yadrolardan boshlanib, uning tolalari ko'prik tomining dorsolateral qismida ko'tariladi va kaudal o'rta miyada (pastki tepaliklar sathi, O1) to'liq kesishib, qarama-qarshi qizil yadro hamda talamusning VLp (Vim) yadrosiga boradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Why does a unilateral lesion of the right cerebellar hemisphere produce ataxia and dysmetria on the SAME (ipsilateral right) side of the body?
q.uz: Nima uchun o'ng miyacha yarimsharining bir tomonlama zararlanishi tananing XUDDI SHU (ipsilateral o'ng) tomonida ataksiya va dismetriya keltirib chiqaradi?

options.en: Double crossing: the right cerebellum projects across the SCP decussation to the LEFT thalamus/motor cortex, whose corticospinal tract then crosses BACK at the pyramidal decussation to the RIGHT spinal cord
options.uz: Ikki marta kesishish: o'ng miyacha SCP kesishmasi orqali CHAP talamus/motor po'stloqqa boradi, u yerdan tushuvchi kortikospinal yo'l esa piramida kesishmasida QAYTA O'NG orqa miyaga o'tadi

options.en: Neither the dentatothalamic tract nor the lateral corticospinal tract crosses the midline
options.uz: Na dentatotalamik yo'l, na lateral kortikospinal yo'l o'rta chiziqni kesib o'tmaydi

options.en: Purkinje cells send direct uncrossed axons down the spinal cord to alpha motor neurons
options.uz: Purkine hujayralari orqa miyadagi alfa-motoneyronlarga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri kesishmagan aksonlar yuboradi

options.en: Spinocerebellar inputs from the left body exclusively control the right limbs
options.uz: Chap tanadan keluvchi spinoserebellyar signallar faqat o'ng oyoq-qo'llarni boshqaradi

why.en: The cerebellum controls the ipsilateral body because of a 'double decussation': (1) ascending dentatothalamic fibres cross at the superior cerebellar peduncle decussation in the caudal midbrain to influence the contralateral motor cortex (and red nucleus), and (2) the descending lateral corticospinal (and rubrospinal) tracts cross back across the midline to innervate motor neurons on the original side.
why.uz: Miyacha tananing o'z tomonini (ipsilateral) 'ikki marta kesishish' tufayli boshqaradi: (1) ko'tariluvchi dentatotalamik tolalar kaudal o'rta miyadagi ustki miyacha oyoqchasi kesishmasida qarama-qarshi motor po'stloqqa (va qizil yadroga) o'tadi, va (2) tushuvchi lateral kortikospinal (hamda rubrospinal) yo'llar o'rta chiziqni qayta kesib o'tib, dastlabki tomondagi motoneyronlarni innervatsiya qiladi.

q.en: What is the 'arbor vitae' ('tree of life') seen on a midsagittal section of the cerebellum?
q.uz: Miyachaning o'rta sagittal kesimida ko'rinadigan 'arbor vitae' ('hayot daraxti') nima?

options.en: The branching medullary core of cerebellar white matter extending into the folia and housing the deep cerebellar nuclei
options.uz: Miyacha bargchalariga (folia) shoxlanib kiruvchi va ichida chuqur yadrolarni saqlovchi miyacha oq moddasi o'zagi

options.en: The choroid plexus vascular tuft of the fourth ventricle roof
options.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha tomidagi xoroid chigal tomir tutami

options.en: The branching dendritic tree of a single Purkinje cell viewed with the naked eye
options.uz: Bitta Purkine hujayrasining oddiy ko'z bilan ko'rinadigan shoxlangan dendrit daraxti

options.en: The arterial branches of the posterior inferior cerebellar artery on the pial surface
options.uz: Orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasining yumshoq parda yuzasidagi shoxlari

why.en: On a sagittal cut through the vermis, the central white matter (corpus medullare / cb-wm) branches into primary and secondary laminae inside the grey-matter folia, creating a fern- or tree-like silhouette historically named the arbor vitae ('tree of life').
why.uz: Chuvalchang orqali o'tgan sagittal kesimda markaziy oq modda (corpus medullare / cb-wm) kulrang modda bargchalari (folia) ichiga birlamchi va ikkilamchi plastinkalar bo'lib shoxlanadi va tarixan 'arbor vitae' ('hayot daraxti') deb atalgan daraxtsimon siluetni hosil qiladi.

q.en: Which functional division of the cerebellum (spinocerebellum / paleocerebellum) occupies the vermis and paravermal (intermediate) zone and receives continuous somatosensory feedback from the spinal cord to adjust ongoing posture and limb movement?
q.uz: Miyachaning qaysi funksional bo'limi (spinoserebellum / paleoserebellum) chuvalchang va paravermal (oraliq) zonani egallab, davom etayotgan tana holati va qo'l-oyoq harakatlarini to'g'rilash uchun orqa miyadan uzluksiz somatosensor qayta aloqa oladi?

options.en: Spinocerebellum — projecting via the fastigial (vermis) and interposed/globose-emboliform (paravermis) nuclei
options.uz: Spinoserebellum — cho'qqi (chuvalchang) va oraliq/sharsimon-tiqinsimon (paravermis) yadrolar orqali proyeksiya beruvchi bo'lim

options.en: Cerebrocerebellum — lateral hemispheres (Crus I/II) projecting via the dentate nucleus for motor planning and cognition
options.uz: Serebroserebellum — harakatni rejalashtirish va kognitsiya uchun tishsimon yadro orqali proyeksiya beruvchi lateral yarimsharlar (Crus I/II)

options.en: Vestibulocerebellum — flocculonodular lobe (lobule X) projecting directly to vestibular nuclei
options.uz: Vestibuloserebellum — vestibulyar yadrolarga bevosita proyeksiya beruvchi flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (X bo'lakcha)

options.en: Pontocerebellar tegmentum
options.uz: Pontoserebellyar tegmentum

why.en: The spinocerebellum (paleocerebellum) comprises the midline vermis (controlling axial/proximal musculature via the fastigial nucleus) and the adjacent intermediate/paravermal cortex (controlling distal limb execution via the interposed [globose + emboliform] nuclei), heavily represented in the anterior lobe (I–V) and lobule VIII.
why.uz: Spinoserebellum (paleoserebellum) o'rta chiziqdagi chuvalchang (cho'qqi yadrosi orqali tana o'qi va proksimal mushaklarni boshqaradi) hamda unga tutash oraliq/paravermal po'stloqdan (oraliq [sharsimon + tiqinsimon] yadrolar orqali distal oyoq-qo'l harakatlarini boshqaradi) iborat bo'lib, oldingi bo'lakda (I–V) va VIII bo'lakchada keng namoyon bo'lgan.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Which is the largest and phylogenetically newest division of the human cerebellum (cerebrocerebellum / neocerebellum), greatly expanded in the posterior lobe (lobules VI, Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) and projecting through the dentate nucleus?
q.uz: Inson miyachasining orqa bo'lakda (VI, Crus I, Crus II, VIIb bo'lakchalar) keskin kengaygan va tishsimon yadro orqali proyeksiya beradigan eng yirik hamda filogenetik eng yangi bo'limi (serebroserebellum / neoserebellum) qaysi?

options.en: Lateral cerebellar hemispheres (cerebrocerebellum), supporting motor planning, skilled coordination, and executive/language cognition
options.uz: Miyachaning lateral yarimsharlari (serebroserebellum) — harakatni rejalashtirish, nozik koordinatsiya hamda ijrochi/nutq kognitsiyasini ta'minlaydi

options.en: Lingula and centralis (lobules I–III) of the anterior vermis
options.uz: Oldingi chuvalchangning tilcha va markaziy bo'lakchalari (I–III bo'lakchalar)

options.en: Flocculus and nodulus (lobule X)
options.uz: Flokkulus va nodulus (X bo'lakcha)

options.en: Fastigial-vestibular midline strip
options.uz: Cho'qqi-vestibulyar o'rta chiziq tasmasi

why.en: The cerebrocerebellum (neocerebellum) comprises the expansive lateral cerebellar hemispheres (especially lobules VI, Crus I, Crus II, and VIIb of the posterior lobe). It receives massive corticopontocerebellar input via the middle cerebellar peduncle and projects via the dentate nucleus and superior cerebellar peduncle to the motor, prefrontal, and parietal association thalamocortical loops.
why.uz: Serebroserebellum (neoserebellum) miyachaning keng lateral yarimsharlaridan (ayniqsa orqa bo'lakning VI, Crus I, Crus II va VIIb bo'lakchalari) iborat. U o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi orqali katta hajmdagi kortikopontoserebellyar signallarni qabul qiladi va tishsimon yadro hamda ustki miyacha oyoqchasi orqali motor, prefrontal va parietal assotsiativ talamokortikal halqalarga proyeksiya beradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do climbing fibres and mossy fibres differ in their anatomical origin, termination layer, and physiological firing pattern on Purkinje cells?
q.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar (climbing fibers) va yo'sinsimon tolalar (mossy fibers) o'zlarining anatomik manbasi, tugash qavati hamda Purkine hujayralaridagi fiziologik impuls berish xususiyati bilan qanday farq qiladi?

options.en: Climbing fibres arise exclusively from the contralateral inferior olive (1:1 onto Purkinje dendrites → complex spikes); mossy fibres arise from spinal/pontine/vestibular nuclei (synapsing on granule cells → parallel fibres → simple spikes)
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar faqat qarama-qarshi pastki olivadan chiqadi (Purkine dendritlarida 1:1 → murakkab spayklar); yo'sinsimon tolalar orqa miya/ko'prik/vestibulyar yadrolardan keladi (donador hujayralarda sinaps → parallel tolalar → oddiy spayklar)

options.en: Mossy fibres arise from the inferior olive and synapse directly on Purkinje cell somata, whereas climbing fibres arise from the pontine nuclei
options.uz: Yo'sinsimon tolalar pastki olivadan chiqib, Purkine hujayralari tanasida sinaps hosil qiladi, chirmashuvchi tolalar esa ko'prik yadrolaridan boshlanadi

options.en: Both climbing and mossy fibres are GABAergic inhibitory afferents originating in the red nucleus
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi va yo'sinsimon tolalarning ikkalasi ham qizil yadrodan boshlanuvchi GAMK-ergik tormozlovchi afferentlardir

options.en: Climbing fibres enter exclusively through the middle cerebellar peduncle, whereas mossy fibres enter only through the superior medullary velum
options.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar faqat o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi orqali, yo'sinsimon tolalar esa faqat ustki miya chodiri orqali kiradi

why.en: Climbing fibres originate exclusively in the contralateral inferior olivary complex, enter via the inferior cerebellar peduncle, and wrap 1:1 around Purkinje cell dendritic trees in the molecular layer to evoke powerful, low-frequency 'complex spikes' (error/teaching signals). All other cerebellar afferents (pontine, spinocerebellar, vestibular, reticular) enter as mossy fibres, exciting granule cells whose T-shaped parallel fibres contact hundreds of thousands of Purkinje cells to drive high-frequency 'simple spikes'.
why.uz: Chirmashuvchi tolalar faqat qarama-qarshi pastki oliva majmuasidan boshlanadi, pastki miyacha oyoqchasi orqali kiradi va molekulyar qavatda Purkine hujayralari dendrit daraxtiga 1:1 nisbatda o'ralib, kuchli, past chastotali 'murakkab spayklar'ni (xato/o'rgatuvchi signallar) chaqiradi. Qolgan barcha afferentlar (ko'prik, spinoserebellyar, vestibulyar, retikulyar) yo'sinsimon tolalar sifatida kirib, donador hujayralarni qo'zg'atadi; ularning T-simon parallel tolalari yuz minglab Purkine hujayralari bilan tutashib, yuqori chastotali 'oddiy spayklar'ni hosil qiladi.

q.en: Contrast the anatomical trajectories of the dorsal spinocerebellar tract (DSCT) and ventral spinocerebellar tract (VSCT) on their way to the spinocerebellum:
q.uz: Spinoserebellumga yo'naluvchi orqa (dorsal) spinoserebellyar yo'l (DSCT) va oldingi (ventral) spinoserebellyar yo'l (VSCT) anatomik yo'nalishlarini taqqoslang:

options.en: DSCT arises from Clarke's column (T1–L2) and enters IPSILATERALLY via the ICP; VSCT crosses in the spinal cord, enters via the SCP, and crosses back inside the cerebellum ('double-crosser')
options.uz: DSCT Klark ustunidan (T1–L2) boshlanib, ICP orqali IPSILATERAL kiradi; VSCT orqa miyada kesishadi, SCP orqali kiradi va miyacha ichida qayta kesishadi ('ikki marta kesishuvchi')

options.en: DSCT enters via the middle cerebellar peduncle, whereas VSCT enters via the juxtarestiform body
options.uz: DSCT o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi orqali, VSCT esa yukstarestiform tana orqali kiradi

options.en: Both DSCT and VSCT cross at the pyramidal decussation and terminate in the contralateral dentate nucleus
options.uz: DSCT va VSCT ning ikkalasi ham piramida kesishmasida kesishib, qarama-qarshi tishsimon yadroda tugaydi

options.en: DSCT conveys upper-limb proprioception from the cuneate nucleus, whereas VSCT conveys vestibular input
options.uz: DSCT ponasimon yadrodan qo'l propriotsepsiyasini, VSCT esa vestibulyar signalni tashiydi

why.en: The dorsal spinocerebellar tract (DSCT) arises from Clarke's nucleus (T1–L2, lower limb/trunk muscle spindles), ascends uncrossed, and enters the cerebellum via the inferior cerebellar peduncle (ICP). The ventral spinocerebellar tract (VSCT, conveying spinal interneuron/Golgi tendon organ copy) crosses in the anterior white commissure of the cord, ascends to enter via the superior cerebellar peduncle (SCP), and crosses a second time within the cerebellar white matter so both tracts ultimately represent the ipsilateral body.
why.uz: Dorsal spinoserebellyar yo'l (DSCT) Klark yadrosidan (T1–L2, oyoq va tana mushak dukchalari) boshlanib, kesishmasdan ko'tariladi va pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ICP) orqali kiradi. Ventral spinoserebellyar yo'l (VSCT, orqa miya oraliq neyronlari/Golji pay reseptorlari nusxasi) orqa miyada oldingi oq bitishmada kesishadi, ustki miyacha oyoqchasi (SCP) orqali kiradi va miyacha oq moddasida ikkinchi marta kesishadi — natijada ikkala yo'l ham tananing o'z (ipsilateral) tomonini aks ettiradi.

q.en: Because Clarke's column ends above C8, how does unconscious proprioceptive information from the UPPER limb and neck reach the spinocerebellum?
q.uz: Klark ustuni C8 dan yuqorida tugashi sababli, QO'L va bo'yindan keluvchi ongsiz propriotseptiv axborot spinoserebellumga qaysi yo'l orqali yetib boradi?

options.en: Via the cuneocerebellar tract — primary afferents ascend in the fasciculus cuneatus to the lateral (accessory) cuneate nucleus in the medulla, which projects ipsilaterally through the ICP
options.uz: Kuneoserebellyar yo'l orqali — birlamchi tolalar ponasimon tutamda uzunchoq miyadagi lateral (qo'shimcha) ponasimon yadrogacha ko'tarilib, ICP orqali ipsilateral miyachaga kiradi

options.en: Via the medial lemniscus directly through the middle cerebellar peduncle
options.uz: Medial qovuzloq orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'rta miyacha oyoqchasidan

options.en: Via the central tegmental tract from the red nucleus
options.uz: Qizil yadrodan markaziy tegmental yo'l orqali

options.en: Via the fasciculus gracilis to the fastigial nucleus
options.uz: Nozik tutam orqali cho'qqi yadrosiga

why.en: The lateral (external or accessory) cuneate nucleus (acn) in the dorsolateral medulla is the upper-limb homologue of Clarke's column. It receives C1–T5 proprioceptive afferents ascending in the cuneate fasciculus and sends uncrossed cuneocerebellar mossy fibres into the cerebellum via the inferior cerebellar peduncle (restiform body).
why.uz: Dorsolateral uzunchoq miyadagi lateral (tashqi yoki qo'shimcha) ponasimon yadro (acn) Klark ustunining qo'l uchun gomologidir. U ponasimon tutamda ko'tariluvchi C1–T5 propriotseptiv tolalarni qabul qiladi va kesishmagan kuneoserebellyar yo'sinsimon tolalarni pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (arqonsimon tana) orqali miyachaga yuboradi.

q.en: How are the two sensorimotor body representations (somatotopic homunculi) organized in the human cerebellar cortex according to probabilistic fMRI/MR mapping (Diedrichsen et al. 2009)?
q.uz: Ehtimoliy fMRI/MR xaritalashga (Diedrichsen va boshq., 2009) ko'ra, inson miyacha po'stlog'idagi ikkita sensorimotor tana xaritasi (somatotopik gomunkuluslar) qayerda joylashgan?

options.en: A primary inverted somatotopic map in the anterior lobe (lobules I–V extending into VI) and a secondary upright representation in lobule VIII of the inferior posterior lobe, separated by cognitive/association zones (Crus I/II)
options.uz: Oldingi bo'lakda (VI ga o'tuvchi I–V bo'lakchalar) birlamchi teskari somatotopik xarita va pastki orqa bo'lakning VIII bo'lakchasida ikkilamchi to'g'ri xarita joylashib, ularning orasini kognitiv/assotsiativ zonalar (Crus I/II) ajratib turadi

options.en: A single motor homunculus restricted entirely to the flocculonodular lobe (lobule X)
options.uz: Butunlay flokkulonodulyar bo'lakda (X bo'lakcha) joylashgan yagona motor gomunkulus

options.en: Left body in the right cerebellar hemisphere and right body in the left cerebellar hemisphere
options.uz: Chap tana o'ng miyacha yarimsharida va o'ng tana chap miyacha yarimsharida

options.en: Motor representation exclusively in Crus I and Crus II, with cognition in lobules I–IV
options.uz: Motor vakillik faqat Crus I va Crus II da, kognitsiya esa I–IV bo'lakchalarda

why.en: Human neuroimaging confirms two distinct ipsilateral sensorimotor body maps: an inverted map in the anterior lobe (leg in lobules I–IV, hand in V, face/lips extending into VI) and a second map in lobule VIII (VIIIa/VIIIb). Between them, the massive expansion of lobule VII (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) connects with prefrontal and parietal association cortices rather than primary motor cortex.
why.uz: Inson neyrovizualizatsiyasi ikkita alohida ipsilateral sensorimotor tana xaritasini tasdiqlaydi: oldingi bo'lakdagi teskari xarita (oyoq I–IV bo'lakchalarda, qo'l V da, yuz/lablar VI gacha davom etadi) va VIII bo'lakchadagi (VIIIa/VIIIb) ikkinchi xarita. Ularning orasida kengaygan VII bo'lakcha (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) birlamchi motor po'stloq bilan emas, balki prefrontal va parietal assotsiativ po'stloq bilan bog'langan.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Match each deep cerebellar nucleus with its primary downstream efferent target:
q.uz: Miyachaning har bir chuqur yadrosini uning asosiy efferent nishoni bilan moslang:

options.en: Fastigial → vestibular nuclei & reticular formation; Interposed (globose/emboliform) → magnocellular red nucleus & VL thalamus; Dentate → parvocellular red nucleus & VLp (Vim) / VA thalamus
options.uz: Cho'qqi (fastigii) → vestibulyar yadrolar va retikulyar formatsiya; Oraliq (sharsimon/tiqinsimon) → yirik hujayrali qizil yadro va VL talamus; Tishsimon (dentatus) → mayda hujayrali qizil yadro va VLp (Vim) / VA talamus

options.en: Fastigial → prefrontal thalamus; Dentate → lateral vestibular nucleus; Interposed → Edinger–Westphal nucleus
options.uz: Cho'qqi → prefrontal talamus; Tishsimon → lateral vestibulyar yadro; Oraliq → Edinger–Vestfal yadrosi

options.en: All four deep nuclei project exclusively to the ipsilateral inferior olivary nucleus via the restiform body
options.uz: To'rtta chuqur yadroning barchasi arqonsimon tana orqali faqat ipsilateral pastki oliva yadrosiga proyeksiya beradi

options.en: Dentate → direct monosynaptic projection to spinal alpha motor neurons
options.uz: Tishsimon → orqa miya alfa-motoneyronlariga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri monosinaptik proyeksiya

why.en: Each longitudinal zone has a dedicated nuclear outflow: (1) medial vermis → fastigial nucleus → bilateral vestibular nuclei and pontomedullary reticular formation (via juxtarestiform body and uncinate fasciculus of Russell); (2) paravermis → interposed (globose + emboliform) nuclei → SCP → contralateral magnocellular red nucleus (rubrospinal) and VL thalamus; (3) lateral hemisphere → dentate nucleus → SCP → contralateral VLp/Vim thalamus (to motor/premotor/prefrontal cortex) and parvocellular red nucleus (to inferior olive).
why.uz: Har bir bo'ylama zona o'z yadroviy chiqish yo'liga ega: (1) medial chuvalchang → cho'qqi yadrosi → ikki tomonlama vestibulyar yadrolar va pontomedullyar retikulyar formatsiya (yukstarestiform tana va Rasselning ilmoqsimon tutami orqali); (2) paravermis → oraliq (sharsimon + tiqinsimon) yadrolar → SCP → qarama-qarshi yirik hujayrali qizil yadro (rubrospinal) va VL talamus; (3) lateral yarimshar → tishsimon yadro → SCP → qarama-qarshi VLp/Vim talamus (motor/premotor/prefrontal po'stloqqa) va mayda hujayrali qizil yadro (pastki olivaga).

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Which midline cerebellar region constitutes the 'oculomotor vermis', calibrating saccadic eye-movement amplitude and smooth pursuit via the caudal fastigial nucleus?
q.uz: O'rta chiziqdagi qaysi miyacha sohasi kaudal cho'qqi yadrosi orqali sakkadik ko'z harakatlari amplitudasini va silliq kuzatuvni kalibrlaydigan 'okulomotor chuvalchang'ni tashkil etadi?

options.en: Posterior superior vermis — lobules VI and VII (declive, folium, and tuber)
options.uz: Orqa ustki chuvalchang — VI va VII bo'lakchalar (declive, folium va tuber)

options.en: Anterior vermis — lobules I–IV (lingula and centralis)
options.uz: Oldingi chuvalchang — I–IV bo'lakchalar (lingula va centralis)

options.en: Lateral Crus II hemisphere
options.uz: Lateral Crus II yarimshari

options.en: Anterior lobe paravermal lobule V
options.uz: Oldingi bo'lak paravermal V bo'lakchasi

why.en: Vermian lobules VI and VII (declive, folium, tuber — together termed the oculomotor vermis) project to the caudal fastigial nucleus (fastigial oculomotor region, FOR) to calibrate saccadic accuracy. Lesions here produce saccadic dysmetria (hypermetric or hypometric saccades) and impaired smooth pursuit, complementing the flocculus/nodulus (lobule X) which stabilizes the vestibulo-ocular reflex and gaze holding.
why.uz: Chuvalchangning VI va VII bo'lakchalari (declive, folium, tuber — birgalikda okulomotor chuvalchang deyiladi) sakkada aniqligini sozlash uchun kaudal cho'qqi yadrosiga (cho'qqi okulomotor sohasi, FOR) proyeksiya beradi. Bu sohaning zararlanishi sakkadik dismetriya (gipermetrik yoki gipometrik sakkadalar) va silliq kuzatuv buzilishini chaqiradi; flokkulus/nodulus (X bo'lakcha) esa vestibulo-okulyar refleks va nigohni ushlab turishni barqarorlashtiradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: Chronic alcoholism and thiamine deficiency selectively degenerate Purkinje cells in which cerebellar region, and what is the signature clinical deficit?
q.uz: Surunkali alkogolizm va tiamin yetishmovchiligi miyachaning qaysi sohasidagi Purkine hujayralarini tanlab yemirilishiga olib keladi va uning xos klinik belgisi nima?

options.en: Anterior superior vermis (lobules I–V) — causing a wide-based truncal and lower-limb gait ataxia with relative sparing of upper-limb finger-to-nose coordination and speech
options.uz: Oldingi ustki chuvalchang (I–V bo'lakchalar) — qo'lning barmoq-burun koordinatsiyasi va nutq nisbatan saqlangan holda, keng qadamli tana va oyoq yurish ataksiyasini chaqiradi

options.en: Lateral posterior lobe (Crus I and Crus II) — causing isolated upper-limb intention tremor and dysarthria with normal gait
options.uz: Lateral orqa bo'lak (Crus I va Crus II) — yurish normal qolgan holda faqat qo'l intension tremori va dizartriyani chaqiradi

options.en: Flocculus (lobule X) — causing isolated bilateral sensorineural deafness
options.uz: Flokkulus (X bo'lakcha) — faqat ikki tomonlama neyrosensor karlikni chaqiradi

options.en: Dentate nucleus — causing palatal myoclonus
options.uz: Tishsimon yadro — tanglay mioklonusini chaqiradi

why.en: Alcoholic/nutritional cerebellar degeneration preferentially causes atrophy of the anterior superior vermis (lobules I–V), where the lower limbs and trunk are somatotopically represented in the inverted anterior-lobe map. Patients present with prominent wide-based stance and gait ataxia and heel-to-shin dysmetria, while upper-limb coordination and oculomotor/speech functions remain comparatively preserved.
why.uz: Alkogolli/alimentar miyacha degeneratsiyasi asosan oldingi ustki chuvalchangning (I–V bo'lakchalar) atrofiyasini chaqiradi; oldingi bo'lakning teskari somatotopik xaritasida aynan shu joyda oyoqlar va tana gavdasi joylashgan. Bemorlarda keng qadamli turish va yurish ataksiyasi hamda tovon-boldir sinamasida dismetriya yaqqol namoyon bo'ladi, qo'l koordinatsiyasi va nutq esa nisbatan saqlanib qoladi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do the three pairs of cerebellar arteries (SCA, AICA, PICA) divide the blood supply of the cerebellar cortex, peduncles, and deep nuclei?
q.uz: Uch juft miyacha arteriyasi (SCA, AICA, PICA) miyacha po'stlog'i, oyoqchalari va chuqur yadrolarining qon ta'minotini qanday taqsimlaydi?

options.en: SCA supplies the superior cerebellar surface, superior peduncle (SCP), and main bulk of the dentate nucleus; AICA supplies the anteroinferior surface, flocculus, and middle peduncle (MCP); PICA supplies the posteroinferior surface/vermis, tonsils (IX), and inferior peduncle (ICP)
options.uz: SCA miyacha ustki yuzasi, ustki oyoqcha (SCP) va tishsimon yadroning asosiy qismini; AICA old-pastki yuza, flokkulus va o'rta oyoqchani (MCP); PICA orqa-pastki yuza/chuvalchang, bodomchalar (IX) va pastki oyoqchani (ICP) qon bilan ta'minlaydi

options.en: PICA supplies the entire superior lobe and SCP; SCA supplies only the cerebellar tonsils and medulla
options.uz: PICA butun ustki bo'lak va SCP ni; SCA esa faqat miyacha bodomchalari va uzunchoq miyani qon bilan ta'minlaydi

options.en: All three cerebellar arteries arise directly from the internal carotid artery
options.uz: Uchala miyacha arteriyasi ham bevosita ichki uyqu arteriyasidan chiqadi

options.en: AICA supplies the dentate nucleus exclusively without contributing to the middle cerebellar peduncle or inner ear
options.uz: AICA o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi yoki ichki quloqqa shox bermasdan, faqat tishsimon yadroni ta'minlaydi

why.en: From rostral to caudal in the vertebrobasilar system: (1) Superior cerebellar artery (SCA, off distal basilar) supplies the superior cortex (anterior lobe + superior posterior lobe), SCP, and deep nuclei (especially dentate); (2) Anterior inferior cerebellar artery (AICA, off caudal basilar) supplies the petrosal/anteroinferior surface, flocculus, MCP, and labyrinthine artery; (3) Posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA, off vertebral) supplies the suboccipital/posteroinferior surface, inferior vermis, tonsils (lobule IX), ICP, and fourth-ventricle choroid plexus.
why.uz: Vertebrobazilyar tizimda rostraldan kaudalga: (1) Ustki miyacha arteriyasi (SCA, distal bazilyar arteriyadan) ustki po'stloqni (oldingi bo'lak + orqa bo'lak ustki qismi), SCP va chuqur yadrolarni (ayniqsa tishsimon yadroni) ta'minlaydi; (2) Oldingi pastki miyacha arteriyasi (AICA, kaudal bazilyar arteriyadan) old-pastki yuzani, flokkulusni, MCP va labirint arteriyasini ta'minlaydi; (3) Orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasi (PICA, umurtqa arteriyasidan) orqa-pastki yuzani, pastki chuvalchangni, bodomchalarni (IX bo'lakcha), ICP va IV qorincha xoroid chigalini ta'minlaydi.

q.en: Which cerebellar lobule forms the cerebellar tonsils on the ventromedial inferior surface, and why is an expansile posterior fossa mass a contraindication to lumbar puncture?
q.uz: Pastki ventromedial yuzadagi miyacha bodomchalarini (tonsilla cerebelli) qaysi bo'lakcha hosil qiladi va nima uchun orqa kalla chuqurchasidagi hajmli hosila bel punksiyasi (lyumbal punksiya) uchun qarshi ko'rsatma hisoblanadi?

options.en: Hemispheric lobule IX (adjacent to the uvula) — lowering lumbar CSF pressure causes downward tonsillar herniation through the foramen magnum, compressing the medulla and cardiorespiratory centres
options.uz: Yarimsharning IX bo'lakchasi (uvula yonida) — belda likvor bosimini tushirish bodomchalarning katta ensa teshigi orqali pastga ponasimon tiqilishiga va uzunchoq miyadagi yurak-nafas markazlarining ezilishiga olib keladi

options.en: Lobule I (lingula) — herniating upward through the foramen of Monro
options.uz: I bo'lakcha (tilcha) — Monro teshigi orqali yuqoriga churra hosil qiladi

options.en: Crus I (lobule VIIa) — compressing the optic chiasm directly
options.uz: Crus I (VIIa bo'lakcha) — ko'ruv kesishmasini bevosita ezadi

options.en: Flocculus (lobule X) — herniating through the jugular foramen
options.uz: Flokkulus (X bo'lakcha) — bo'yinturuq teshigi orqali churra hosil qiladi

why.en: Hemispheric lobule IX corresponds to the cerebellar tonsils (flanking the midline vermian uvula, directly above the foramen magnum). In Chiari I malformation or posterior fossa mass lesions, withdrawing lumbar CSF creates a craniospinal pressure gradient that drives the tonsils downward through the foramen magnum ('coning'), acutely compressing the vital medullary respiratory and vasomotor centres.
why.uz: Yarimsharning IX bo'lakchasi miyacha bodomchalariga (o'rta chiziqdagi chuvalchang tilchasi — uvula ikki yonida, bevosita katta ensa teshigi ustida) to'g'ri keladi. Kiari I malformatsiyasida yoki orqa kalla chuqurchasi hajmli hosilalarida beldan likvor olish kraniospinal bosim gradiyentini yuzaga keltirib, bodomchalarni katta ensa teshigi orqali pastga suradi ('ponalanish') va uzunchoq miyaning hayotiy muhim nafas hamda vazomotor markazlarini o'tkir ezib qo'yadi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2009, NeuroImage — A probabilistic MR atlas of the human cerebellum

q.en: How do cerebellar afferents and efferents use the two subdivisions of the inferior cerebellar peduncle — the restiform body and the juxtarestiform body?
q.uz: Miyacha afferent va efferent tolalari pastki miyacha oyoqchasining ikkita qismidan — arqonsimon tana (corpus restiforme) va yukstarestiform tanadan qanday foydalanadi?

options.en: The restiform body is purely afferent (DSCT, cuneocerebellar, olivocerebellar climbing fibres); the medial juxtarestiform body carries bidirectional vestibulocerebellar and fastigiovestibular/reticular fibres
options.uz: Arqonsimon tana sof afferent (DSCT, kuneoserebellyar, olivoserebellyar chirmashuvchi tolalar); medial yukstarestiform tana esa ikki yo'nalishli vestibuloserebellyar va fastigiovestibulyar/retikulyar tolalarni tashiydi

options.en: The restiform body carries dentatothalamic efferents, whereas the juxtarestiform body carries pontocerebellar afferents
options.uz: Arqonsimon tana dentatotalamik efferentlarni, yukstarestiform tana esa pontoserebellyar afferentlarni tashiydi

options.en: Both subdivisions carry exclusively descending corticospinal motor axons
options.uz: Ikkala qism ham faqat tushuvchi kortikospinal motor aksonlarni tashiydi

options.en: The juxtarestiform body connects the dentate nucleus to the superior colliculus
options.uz: Yukstarestiform tana tishsimon yadroni ustki tepalik bilan bog'laydi

why.en: The inferior cerebellar peduncle (ICP) has two parts: (1) the larger lateral restiform body is purely afferent (dorsal spinocerebellar, cuneocerebellar, trigeminocerebellar, and crossed olivocerebellar climbing fibres); (2) the smaller medial juxtarestiform body is bidirectional, carrying primary/secondary vestibular afferents to the flocculonodular lobe and Purkinje/fastigial efferents back to the vestibular nuclei and reticular formation.
why.uz: Pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ICP) ikki qismdan iborat: (1) yirikroq lateral arqonsimon tana (corpus restiforme) sof afferent bo'lib, dorsal spinoserebellyar, kuneoserebellyar, trigeminoserebellyar va kesishgan olivoserebellyar chirmashuvchi tolalarni olib kiradi; (2) kichikroq medial yukstarestiform tana ikki yo'nalishli bo'lib, flokkulonodulyar bo'lakka vestibulyar afferentlarni va u yerdan Purkine/cho'qqi yadrosi efferentlarini vestibulyar yadrolar hamda retikulyar formatsiyaga qaytarib olib chiqadi.

q.en: Compare Patient A (7-year-old child with a midline tumour arising from the roof of the fourth ventricle: severe truncal instability, falling backward while sitting, titubation, and positional downbeat nystagmus, but normal finger-to-nose testing when lying supine) with Patient B (62-year-old with right arm intention tremor, past-pointing dysmetria, dysdiadochokinesia, and ipsilateral hypotonia). Where are the two lesions?
q.uz: A bemorni (IV qorincha tomidan o'sib chiqqan o'rta chiziq o'smasi bor 7 yoshli bola: o'tirganda orqaga yiqilish bilan kechuvchi og'ir tana nomutanosibligi, titubatsiya va pozitsion pastga uruvchi nistagm, ammo yotgan holatda barmoq-burun sinamasi normal) B bemor bilan (o'ng qo'lda intension tremor, mo'ljaldan o'tib ketish dismetriyasi, disdiadoxokineziya va ipsilateral gipotoniya bor 62 yoshli bemor) taqqoslang. Ikkala o'choq qayerda joylashgan?

options.en: Patient A: midline vermis / flocculonodular lobe (nodulus X and fastigial nucleus); Patient B: right lateral cerebellar hemisphere and/or right dentate nucleus
options.uz: A bemor: o'rta chiziq chuvalchangi / flokkulonodulyar bo'lak (nodulus X va cho'qqi yadrosi); B bemor: o'ng lateral miyacha yarimshari va/yoki o'ng tishsimon yadro

options.en: Patient A: left lateral cerebellar hemisphere; Patient B: left cerebellar hemisphere (contralateral to the ataxic arm)
options.uz: A bemor: chap lateral miyacha yarimshari; B bemor: chap miyacha yarimshari (ataksiyali qo'lga qarama-qarshi)

options.en: Patient A: bilateral dentate nuclei; Patient B: midline flocculonodular lobe
options.uz: A bemor: ikki tomonlama tishsimon yadrolar; B bemor: o'rta chiziq flokkulonodulyar bo'lagi

options.en: Patient A: anterior limb of the internal capsule; Patient B: contralateral subthalamic nucleus
options.uz: A bemor: ichki kapsula oldingi oyoqchasi; B bemor: qarama-qarshi subtalamik yadro

why.en: Midline vermian / flocculonodular lesions (classic in childhood medulloblastoma invading the nodulus X and fastigial nucleus at the fourth-ventricle roof) disrupt axial/vestibular control, causing truncal ataxia (inability to sit or stand without support), head/trunk titubation, and nystagmus while sparing supine appendicular coordination. Lateral hemispheric / dentate lesions (Patient B) disrupt the ipsilateral cerebrocerebellar loop, producing appendicular dysmetria, kinetic/intention tremor, dysdiadochokinesia, and hypotonia on the same (right) side.
why.uz: O'rta chiziq chuvalchang / flokkulonodulyar zararlanishlar (bolalikdagi medulloblastomaning IV qorincha tomidagi nodulus X va cho'qqi yadrosiga o'sib kirishiga xos) tana o'qi/vestibulyar boshqaruvni izdan chiqarib, yotganda qo'l-oyoq koordinatsiyasi saqlangan holda tana ataksiyasi (tayanchsiz o'tira olmaslik yoki tura olmaslik), bosh/tana titubatsiyasi va nistagmni chaqiradi. Lateral yarimshar / tishsimon yadro zararlanishi (B bemor) esa ipsilateral serebroserebellyar halqani buzib, xuddi shu (o'ng) tomonda qo'l-oyoq dismetriyasi, kinetik/intension tremor, disdiadoxokineziya va gipotoniyani yuzaga keltiradi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: Trace the three limbs of the Guillain–Mollaret triangle (dentato-rubro-olivary circuit). Why does a haemorrhage in the right dentate nucleus (or right SCP) cause delayed HYPERTROPHIC olivary degeneration of the LEFT inferior olive, whereas a lesion of the left inferior cerebellar peduncle (ICP) does NOT?
q.uz: Giyen–Mollare uchburchagining (dentato-rubro-olivar halqa) uchta bo'g'inini kuzating. Nima uchun o'ng tishsimon yadrodagi (yoki o'ng SCP dagi) qon quyilish kechikkan CHAP pastki oliva GIPERTROFIK degeneratsiyasini chaqiradi, ammo chap pastki miyacha oyoqchasi (ICP) zararlanishi buni CHAQIRMAYDI?

options.en: The triangle runs unilaterally from right dentate → crossed via SCP to LEFT red nucleus → down LEFT central tegmental tract (CTT) to LEFT inferior olive → crossed via ICP back to right cerebellum; deafferentation of the olive (dentate/SCP or CTT lesion) triggers trans-synaptic vacuolar hypertrophy, whereas ICP lesions are post-olivary (efferent)
options.uz: Uchburchak bir yo'nalishda o'ng tishsimon yadrodan → SCP orqali kesishib CHAP qizil yadroga → CHAP markaziy tegmental yo'l (CTT) bo'ylab CHAP pastki olivaga → ICP orqali kesishib qayta o'ng miyachaga boradi; olivaning deafferentatsiyasi (dentat/SCP yoki CTT zararlanishi) trans-sinaptik vakuolyar gipertrofiyani chaqiradi, ICP esa olivadan keyingi (efferent) bo'g'indir

options.en: The right dentate projects uncrossed via the CTT directly to the right inferior olive
options.uz: O'ng tishsimon yadro CTT orqali kesishmasdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri o'ng pastki olivaga boradi

options.en: Hypertrophic olivary degeneration occurs only when the middle cerebellar peduncle is transected
options.uz: Gipertrofik oliva degeneratsiyasi faqat o'rta miyacha oyoqchasi kesilganda yuzaga keladi

options.en: ICP lesions cause bilateral olivary hypertrophy within 2 hours of stroke
options.uz: ICP zararlanishi insultdan 2 soat o'tib ikki tomonlama oliva gipertrofiyasini chaqiradi

why.en: The Guillain–Mollaret triangle is unidirectional: (1) Dentate nucleus → ascends via SCP and crosses at the caudal midbrain decussation (O1) to the contralateral parvocellular red nucleus; (2) Red nucleus → descends ipsilaterally in the central tegmental tract (CTT) to the inferior olivary nucleus (ION); (3) ION → sends climbing fibres across the midline via the ICP back to the original dentate/Purkinje cortex. Interrupting the first two afferent limbs (dentate/SCP or contralateral CTT) deafferents the ION, causing unique trans-synaptic olivary enlargement/T2 hyperintensity and ~2 Hz symptomatic oculopalatal tremor months later. Interrupting the third limb (ICP) cuts olivary axons rather than olivary inputs and does not cause hypertrophy.
why.uz: Giyen–Mollare uchburchagi bir yo'nalishlidir: (1) Tishsimon yadro → SCP orqali ko'tarilib, kaudal o'rta miya kesishmasida (O1) qarama-qarshi mayda hujayrali qizil yadroga o'tadi; (2) Qizil yadro → markaziy tegmental yo'l (CTT) bo'ylab ipsilateral pastki oliva yadrosiga (ION) tushadi; (3) ION → chirmashuvchi tolalarni o'rta chiziq orqali kesib o'tib, ICP orqali dastlabki tishsimon yadro/Purkine po'stlog'iga qaytaradi. Dastlabki ikki afferent bo'g'inning (tishsimon/SCP yoki qarama-qarshi CTT) uzilishi ION ni deafferentatsiyaga uchratib, bir necha oydan so'ng noyob trans-sinaptik oliva kattalashishi (T2 giperintensivligi) va ~2 Gs simptomatik okulopalatal tremorni chaqiradi. Uchinchi bo'g'inning (ICP) zararlanishi esa olivaga kiruvchi emas, undan chiquvchi aksonlarni uzadi va gipertrofiya chaqirmaydi.

sources.title: Diedrichsen et al. 2011, NeuroImage — Imaging the deep cerebellar nuclei: a probabilistic atlas and normalization procedure

q.en: How do you clinically differentiate a classic superior cerebellar artery (SCA) territorial infarct from an isolated cerebellar-branch posterior inferior cerebellar artery (PICA) infarct, and what is the life-threatening neurosurgical complication of a large PICA stroke?
q.uz: Klinik jihatdan klassik ustki miyacha arteriyasi (SCA) havzasi infarktini orqa pastki miyacha arteriyasining (PICA) miyacha shoxi infarktidan qanday farqlaysiz va yirik PICA insultining hayotga xavf soluvchi neyroxirurgik asorati nima?

options.en: SCA infarct involves the dentate nucleus, SCP, and dorsolateral pontine tegmentum (prominent ipsilateral limb intention tremor/dysmetria, scanning dysarthria, ipsilateral Horner, contralateral pain/temp loss with minimal vertigo); large PICA infarct causes acute severe vertigo/truncal ataxia and can swell within 24–72 h to compress the 4th ventricle (acute obstructive hydrocephalus) and brainstem
options.uz: SCA infarkti tishsimon yadro, SCP va dorsolateral ko'prik tegmentumini qamrab oladi (bosh aylanishi minimal bo'lgan holda yaqqol ipsilateral qo'l-oyoq intension tremori/dismetriyasi, skanerlovchi dizartriya, ipsilateral Gorner va kontralateral og'riq/harorat yo'qolishi); yirik PICA infarkti esa o'tkir kuchli bosh aylanishi/tana ataksiyasini chaqiradi hamda 24–72 soat ichida shishib, IV qorinchani (o'tkir obstruktiv gidrosefaliya) va miya ustunini ezib qo'yishi mumkin

options.en: SCA infarct causes ipsilateral facial paralysis and deafness, whereas PICA infarct causes bitemporal hemianopia
options.uz: SCA infarkti ipsilateral yuz falaji va karlikni, PICA infarkti esa bitemporal gemianopsiyani chaqiradi

options.en: PICA supplies the dentate nucleus exclusively, so PICA strokes never cause vertigo or hydrocephalus
options.uz: PICA faqat tishsimon yadroni ta'minlaydi, shuning uchun PICA insultlari hech qachon bosh aylanishi yoki gidrosefaliya chaqirmaydi

options.en: SCA infarcts routinely require lumbar puncture decompression
options.uz: SCA infarktlari odatda bel punksiyasi orqali dekompressiya qilishni talab etadi

why.en: Because the SCA supplies the superior cerebellar hemisphere, the bulk of the dentate nucleus, the SCP, and the dorsolateral rostral pontine tegmentum (spinothalamic tract + descending sympathetic fibres), SCA strokes produce severe ipsilateral limb kinetic tremor/dysmetria and dysarthria (plus ipsilateral Horner and contralateral body spinothalamic loss if the tegmental branch is occluded) with little vertigo. Conversely, PICA strokes hit the posteroinferior vermis/hemisphere (vestibulocerebellar connections), mimicking acute vestibular neuritis with explosive vertigo, nausea, and truncal ataxia; space-occupying cytotoxic oedema in the tight posterior fossa can efface the fourth ventricle (acute hydrocephalus) and cause tonsillar/upward herniation within 24–72 hours, requiring urgent suboccipital decompressive craniectomy.
why.uz: SCA miyacha ustki yarimsharini, tishsimon yadroning asosiy qismini, SCP ni va ko'prik rostral dorsolateral tegmentumini (spinotalamik yo'l + tushuvchi simpatik tolalar) ta'minlagani uchun, SCA insultlari bosh aylanishi deyarli bo'lmagan holda og'ir ipsilateral qo'l-oyoq kinetik tremori/dismetriyasi va dizartriyani (tegmental shox berkilsa, ipsilateral Gorner va kontralateral tana og'riq/harorat yo'qolishi bilan birga) chaqiradi. Aksincha, PICA insultlari orqa-pastki chuvalchang/yarimsharni (vestibuloserebellyar aloqalar) zararlab, kuchli bosh aylanishi, ko'ngil aynishi va tana ataksiyasi bilan o'tkir vestibulyar nevritni eslatadi; tor orqa kalla chuqurchasidagi shish 24–72 soat ichida IV qorinchani bekilib qolishiga (o'tkir gidrosefaliya) va bodomchalar churrasiga olib kelib, shoshilinch suboksipital dekompressiv kraniektomiyani talab qilishi mumkin.

q.en: What is the anatomical basis of (1) the Cerebellar Cognitive Affective Syndrome (CCAS / Schmahmann syndrome) in adults and (2) Post-operative Cerebellar Mutism Syndrome (posterior fossa syndrome) in children after fourth-ventricle tumour resection?
q.uz: (1) Kattalardagi Miyacha kognitiv-affektiv sindromi (CCAS / Shmamann sindromi) hamda (2) bolalarda IV qorincha o'smasi olib tashlangandan keyin rivojlanadigan Operatsiyadan keyingi miyacha mutizmi sindromining (orqa kalla chuqurchasi sindromi) anatomik asosi nima?

options.en: CCAS results from posterior lobe neocerebellar lesions (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) disrupting dentato-thalamo-prefrontal/parietal loops; cerebellar mutism results from bilateral surgical/oedema disruption of the proximal dentato-rubro-thalamic outflow (dentate nuclei and superior cerebellar peduncles)
options.uz: CCAS orqa bo'lak neoserebellyar sohalarining (Crus I, Crus II, VIIb) zararlanishi natijasida dentato-talamo-prefrontal/parietal halqalarning uzilishidan kelib chiqadi; miyacha mutizmi esa proksimal dentato-rubro-talamik chiqish yo'lining (tishsimon yadrolar va ustki miyacha oyoqchalari) ikki tomonlama jarrohlik/shish tufayli shikastlanishidan yuzaga keladi

options.en: CCAS is caused by isolated anterior-lobe (lobules I–IV) lesions, whereas cerebellar mutism is caused by damage to Broca's area during posterior fossa surgery
options.uz: CCAS faqat oldingi bo'lak (I–IV bo'lakchalar) zararlanishidan, miyacha mutizmi esa orqa kalla chuqurchasi operatsiyasi vaqtida Broka markazi shikastlanishidan kelib chiqadi

options.en: Both syndromes result from isolated damage to the dorsal spinocerebellar tract in the cervical cord
options.uz: Ikkala sindrom ham bo'yin orqa miyasida dorsal spinoserebellyar yo'lning yakka zararlanishidan kelib chiqadi

options.en: Cerebellar mutism is caused by unilateral injury to the flocculus (lobule X)
options.uz: Miyacha mutizmi flokkulusning (X bo'lakcha) bir tomonlama shikastlanishidan kelib chiqadi

why.en: Posterior lobe hemispheric areas (especially Crus I, Crus II, and VIIb) form closed-loop circuits via the ventral/caudal dentate nucleus and thalamus with prefrontal, posterior parietal, and superior temporal cortices; lesions there produce CCAS (executive dysfunction, visuospatial deficits, agrammatism/prosodic changes, and affective blunting or disinhibition) often without severe motor ataxia. In children after midline posterior-fossa tumour resection, bilateral disruption of the dentate nuclei and/or superior cerebellar peduncles (dentato-rubro-thalamo-cortical tract) causes cerebello-cerebral diaschisis and the posterior fossa syndrome (delayed-onset transient mutism evolving into dysarthria, emotional lability, hypotonia, and ataxia).
why.uz: Orqa bo'lak yarimshar sohalari (ayniqsa Crus I, Crus II va VIIb) tishsimon yadroning ventral/kaudal qismi va talamus orqali prefrontal, orqa parietal hamda ustki chakka po'stlog'i bilan yopiq halqalar hosil qiladi; bu joyning zararlanishi og'ir motor ataksiyasiz ham CCAS (ijrochi disfunksiya, fazoviy-ko'ruv buzilishlari, agrammatizm/prosodiya o'zgarishi va emotsional to'mtoqlashuv yoki tormozlanishning yo'qolishi) chaqiradi. Bolalarda o'rta chiziq orqa kalla chuqurchasi o'smasi olib tashlangach, tishsimon yadrolar va/yoki ustki miyacha oyoqchalarining (dentato-rubro-talamo-kortikal yo'l) ikki tomonlama shikastlanishi serebello-serebral diasxiz va orqa kalla chuqurchasi sindromini (1–2 kundan so'ng boshlanib, dizartriyaga o'tuvchi vaqtinchalik mutizm, emotsional labillik, gipotoniya va ataksiya) yuzaga keltiradi.

q.en: A 58-year-old patient presents with progressive gait and limb ataxia, orthostatic hypotension, and urinary retention. Axial T2 MRI of the pons shows a cruciform hyperintensity ('hot-cross-bun sign') along with atrophy and T2 change in the middle cerebellar peduncles. Degeneration of which white-matter tracts produces this MRI sign?
q.uz: 58 yoshli bemor kuchayib boruvchi yurish va qo'l-oyoq ataksiyasi, ortostatik gipotenziya hamda siydik tutilishi bilan murojaat qildi. Ko'prikning aksial T2 MRT tasvirida o'rta miyacha oyoqchalarining atrofiyasi va T2 o'zgarishi bilan birga xochsimon giperintensivlik ('hot-cross-bun' belgisi) ko'rinadi. Qaysi oq modda yo'llarining degeneratsiyasi ushbu MRT belgisini hosil qiladi?

options.en: Selective degeneration of the transverse pontocerebellar fibres and median pontine raphe crossing into the middle cerebellar peduncles, with relative sparing of the dorsolateral superior cerebellar peduncles and ventrolateral corticospinal bundles (characteristic of MSA-C)
options.uz: O'rta miyacha oyoqchalariga o'tuvchi ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalar va ko'prik o'rta chiziq choki (raphe) ning tanlab yemirilishi, bunda dorsolateral ustki miyacha oyoqchalari va ventrolateral kortikospinal tutamlar nisbatan saqlanib qoladi (MSA-C ga xos)

options.en: Selective demyelination of the superior cerebellar peduncle decussation in the midbrain tegmentum
options.uz: O'rta miya tegmentumidagi ustki miyacha oyoqchasi kesishmasining tanlab demiyelinizatsiyasi

options.en: Hypertrophy of the bilateral inferior olivary nuclei in the rostral medulla
options.uz: Rostral uzunchoq miyadagi ikki tomonlama pastki oliva yadrolarining gipertrofiyasi

options.en: Calcification of the four deep cerebellar nuclei around the fourth ventricle
options.uz: To'rtinchi qorincha atrofidagi to'rtta chuqur miyacha yadrosining kalsifikatsiyasi

why.en: In multiple system atrophy, cerebellar type (MSA-C, olivopontocerebellar atrophy), loss of basilar pontine neurons and their myelinated transverse pontocerebellar fibres (entering the middle cerebellar peduncles, MCP) produces a horizontal + vertical T2-hyperintense cross in the basis pontis ('hot-cross-bun sign'), while the four quadrants containing the descending corticospinal tracts (and the dorsally placed SCPs) remain comparatively dark/preserved.
why.uz: Multi-tizimli atrofiyaning miyacha shaklida (MSA-C, olivopontoserebellyar atrofiya) bazilyar ko'prik neyronlari va ularning o'rta miyacha oyoqchalariga (MCP) kiruvchi miyelinlashgan ko'ndalang pontoserebellyar tolalarining yo'qolishi ko'prik asosida gorizontal va vertikal T2-giperintensiv xoch ('hot-cross-bun' belgisi) hosil qiladi; tushuvchi kortikospinal yo'llarni (hamda dorsal joylashgan SCP larni) o'z ichiga olgan to'rtta kvadrant esa nisbatan to'q/saqlangan qoladi.
